text:
sophia: hey team, first week here! setting up a small demo and CI to hit the hosted sandbox. where do i get a dev key, can i make ephemeral ones for PR builds, and what are safe quotas so we don't get 429s?

devex: welcome :wave: Console -> API Keys for key creation. choose Ephemeral for short-lived PR keys (1-8h). defaults are conservative (usually ~50-100 reqs/min per project), token throughput and concurrency limited. what are your expected QPS and response size?

sophia: demo + CI: 3 concurrent runners, ~15 rps each for bursts, responses ~300 tokens. also want per-build keys created automatically.

infra-ops: short bursts like that are normally fine, but token size multiplies load. for auto key creation use the internal key endpoint with a service account that has limited perms. don't create hundreds of keys/hr without talking to infra. if you expect spikes, file a quota request (Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests) with project id and time window.

security: prefer ephemeral keys + minimal scopes. if you automate creation, constrain the service account and enable audit logs. add a CI step to scrub logs and reject artifacts containing tokens.

liam: quick tip: always set max_tokens and pin a model in requests to keep latency and costs predictable. example curl we use for smoke tests:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1-small","input":"smoke","max_tokens":300}'
```

sophia: if we do hit 429s in CI what's the best way to handle it?

devex: implement exponential backoff with jitter, respect Retry-After header, and fail fast for critical tests. for scheduled demos, request a temporary uplift and include CIDR if you want an IP allowlist.

infra-ops: note: allowlist helps networking but doesn't bypass rate quotas. include project id if CI shares projects with other teams. ping infra-ops here if you need an expedite.

onboarding-bot: reminder: new-hires checklist item "Create ephemeral sandbox key" assigned to @sophia is still open.

sophia: thanks — created ephemeral key (3h TTL), added to CI secret store, filed quota request for a 2-hour bump (target 120 rps) and included CIDR for demo host. will monitor and update here.

devex: great, we'll add a short alert on the project and watch for 429 spikes during your window. :thumbsup:
